steps.stdout:
Create the project's Mattermost integration when it has none, or change the
one it has; only the flags passed are sent, so the rest keep their values. The
create is the API's create-or-replace: a row another writer adds between
the read and the POST is replaced rather than refused.

Creating needs --webhook-url - (HTTPS) or --webhook-url-file <path>; --active does not apply to a new
integration, which is created active. On an existing integration
--webhook-url cannot be emptied, --channel-name '' clears the channel, and
each event flag merges into the stored toggles.

The webhook URL is a credential: --webhook-url - reads it from stdin, --webhook-url-file
reads it from a file (- reads stdin there too), one stdin reader per
command; the one line ending a pipe or file adds is not part of the value.

Usage:
  kaneo integration mattermost set [flags]

Flags:
      --active                     deliver events; =false pauses delivery
      --channel-name string        the channel events are posted to; '' clears it
  -h, --help                       help for set
      --task-comment-created       a comment is added to a task
      --task-created               a task is created
      --task-description-changed   a task's description changes
      --task-priority-changed      a task's priority changes
      --task-status-changed        a task changes status
      --task-title-changed         a task's title changes
      --webhook-url string         the Mattermost incoming webhook URL (HTTPS); - reads it from stdin, --webhook-url-file reads it from a file
      --webhook-url-file string    read the webhook URL from a file; - reads stdin

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --jq string          filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   per-request timeout (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)
